descriptors.concept_name: Black Money and Imposition of Tax Framework
descriptors.definition: The framework establishes stringent taxation on undisclosed foreign income and assets held by individuals. It aims to deter and penalize foreign assets accumulated outside the country without proper tax disclosures.
instrument_references: The Black Money and Imposition of Tax Act, 2015
exclusion: Domestic undisclosed income governed solely by standard domestic tax codes without foreign elements
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from standard domestic tax evasion provisions by its specific focus on extraterritorial assets and distinct penalty structures.

descriptors.concept_name: Basis of Charge for Foreign Income and Assets
descriptors.definition: Every applicable assessee is charged tax at a specific statutory rate on their undisclosed foreign income and asset values. The taxable event and timing depend on when the asset or income is identified or acquired under relevant provisions.
inclusion: Taxation of foreign assets at 30 percent
Assessment based on discovery by authorities
exclusion: Assets fully disclosed under applicable legal compliance windows
nearby_distinctions: Differs from routine annual income tax calculations by applying a specialized punitive rate and triggering upon official notice rather than standard filing cycles for specific assets.

descriptors.concept_name: Penalties for Foreign Income and Asset Non-Compliance
descriptors.definition: Assessees face financial penalties amounting to multiples of computed tax or fixed monetary fines for failing to disclose foreign assets or file required returns. Specific monetary thresholds and asset types provide exemptions from these penalties under defined conditions.
inclusion: Penalties equal to three times the tax computed
Fixed sum penalties for omission of foreign asset information
exclusion: Low-value bank accounts and minor aggregate asset holdings within statutory monetary limits
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from prosecution as these represent administrative financial sanctions rather than criminal imprisonment offenses.

descriptors.definition: Willful failures to furnish returns, report foreign assets, or attempts to evade tax carry criminal liability including rigorous imprisonment and fines. These prosecution proceedings operate independently of regular administrative tax assessments or time limitations.
inclusion: Mandatory prison terms for tax evasion attempts
exclusion: Defaults remedied by filing returns prior to the expiration of the relevant assessment year where specified
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from civil penalties by involving criminal court trials, harsher personal liberties restrictions, and mandatory minimum imprisonment terms.
